arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production raster sprite source for HARVEST THE NIGHT.
Primary request: A044 tarp_tall, EXACTLY FOUR states of the same khaki cover in one horizontal strip.
Input images: Image1 accepted tarp identity master for cloth/rope/pegs; Image2 reference sheet for camera/materials only, no objects to draw.
Style: hand-crafted pixel art, LARGE coherent clusters, coloured outlines, restrained texture, clear cloth planes, neutral daytime upper-left light.
Family: weathered khaki canvas draped over an unreadable defence, rope round middle, two small wooden pegs. Same cloth colours: bone_dark/wood_light/soil_light/soil_dark shading, gold_dark rope, wood_dark pegs. No green or blue.
Exact native canvas 16x32, pivot (8,28). COVERED visible 12x24, ground base centred. ONE common scale for ALL four cells; smaller airborne bundle stays naturally smaller.
STRIP ordered poses: (1) COVERED whole lumpy canvas, lowest row 27; (2) TORN same cover with ripped hanging flap, dark hole revealing shadow only, one rope snapped; alpha shape changes, same base; (3) YANK cloth whipped up toward west/left, lower half gone, bunched ABOVE the cover's old top; (4) AWAY small crumpled bundle flying at UPPER LEFT, smaller area, NOT centred on ground. Nothing of a defence is drawn underneath or into any cell.
Equal virtual cells, huge transparent gutters, no labels/separators. Keep common COVERED ground point in every virtual cell as a blank registration reference; airborne poses visibly lifted above it, never moved back onto ground just to fit a bounding box. Whole and torn share baseline. Upper-left bundle remains within native canvas with clear edge. Lay out with plenty of empty TOP space for YANK/AWAY. Final flight object edges inside frame.
True alpha0 outside cloth/rope/pegs. No ground/grass/tower/shadow/glow/haze/blur/gradient/text/UI or fine speckle. Camera fixed; do not enlarge small poses or stretch cloth across cells.
CORRECTION: Image3 edit target. Fix only the TALL footprint fit. This is NOT another squat tower cover: body must be a tall narrow post shroud,12wide x24high, aspectratio0.5. Current rawwhole399x391 yields24x24 and clips16pxcanvas. Re-author as HALF the width at unchanged height: tall thin lumpy clothwrappedpost, same khaki/rope style; keep all four cells at shared scale. Covered and torn same baseline.
Airborne cloth must fit smallcanvas: YANK bunched smallmass about12wide x8high native atupperleft, not a giant clothflag; AWAY tinybundle about6wide x4high native, upperleft. For this source scale, YANKabout195wide x130high, AWAYabout100wide x65high. Coveredgroundbaseline remains aroundy790, coveredtop400; airborne toparoundy360 orhigher but notabove350. No pegs attached to flyingcloth. No extra objects or shadow. Maintain equalcells/gutters, true transparency.
